acceptanceCovered: PUT /api/user/avatar accepts one authenticated multipart avatar upload and returns the serialized user with a private file URL. Auth guard, serializer, multipart contract, and response were reviewed; focused E2E passed.
Only JPEG, PNG, and WebP signatures are accepted, and uploads are limited to 2 MiB. Magic-byte validation, exact-limit behavior, and oversized upload behavior are covered by focused tests.

Avatar replacement serializes per-user updates and retries stale attachment cleanup on a later upload. The handler locks the user row, retains failed cleanup rows, and records failed partial-file cleanup for a later retry.
Authentication, upload validation, storage failure compensation, and API contract have focused unit and E2E coverage. Eight unit tests, three E2E tests, build, lint, and diff checks passed.
regressionChecked: User response serialization and token preservation
Private attachment storage key and metadata ownership
Concurrent avatar replacement serialization through a pessimistic user-row lock
Stale file cleanup and durable cleanup retry markers
Multipart upload count, size, and invalid-file mapping
